verdict.rationale: Ramp offers multiple autonomous background automations (auto-receipt capture, invoice matching/coding/routing, hotel rebooking, auto top-up, ERP sync) that run without manual intervention, and provides MCP/CLI/API access for building custom automations. However, these are mostly pre-built vendor features rather than a general user-configurable automation framework, so evidence of an open-ended 'set up your own autonomous automations' capability is limited.
